sources.content: # nimbalt/worker. This image runs a Nimbalt queue worker that pulls jobs from Redis and executes them as Python callables. It is built on `python:3.12-slim-bookworm` and runs as the non-root user `nimbalt` with UID 10001. The entrypoint is `/usr/local/bin/nimbalt-worker`, and the default command is `run --queues default`. The image exposes port 9187 for Prometheus metrics. Mount your job code at `/app/jobs`; the worker adds that path to `PYTHONPATH` at startup.

Environment variables. `NIMBALT_REDIS_URL` sets the broker address and defaults to `redis://redis:6379/0`. `NIMBALT_CONCURRENCY` sets the number of worker processes and defaults to 4. `NIMBALT_JOB_TIMEOUT` is the maximum run time for one job in seconds, default 300. `NIMBALT_LOG_FORMAT` accepts `json` or `text` and defaults to `json`. Health check: the image runs `nimbalt-worker ping` every 30 seconds and marks the container unhealthy after 3 failed checks in a row. Mount `/tmp` as a tmpfs volume.
